method: Author recomputation of synthetic SI examples; not independent engineering design approval.

checks.boundary: Constant waterplane; unchanged floating displacement cancels.
checks.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設直壁閘室面積3000m²、升差10m且浮船排水量不變，ΔV=AΔh=30000m³；未計漏水與進出船交換。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume a vertical-wall chamber area3000m²,lift10m and unchanged floating displacement. ΔV=AΔh=30000m³, excluding leakage and vessel-entry exchange.

checks.boundary: No external inflow/outflow, shared datum and fixed areas.
checks.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設閘室3000m²在10m、池6000m²在4m，zf=(3000×10+6000×4)/9000=6m，轉移水量12000m³。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume chamber3000m² at10m and basin6000m² at4m. Final zf=6m by area weighting, transferring12000m³ with no external flows.

checks.boundary: Resting endpoints, no pumping or energy recovery.
checks.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設水1000kg/m³、兩池面積3000與6000m²、初水位差6m，耗散E=ρg[A1A2/(A1+A2)]Δh²/2=353.16MJ。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume water1000kg/m³,areas3000 and6000m² and initial head difference6m. Dissipated E=ρg[A1A2/(A1+A2)]Δh²/2=353.16MJ without recovery.

checks.boundary: Same cycle and denominator; not comparison to differently sized locks.
checks.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設同一循環總交換30000m³、池回用18000m³，r=60%，外部補水12000m³；此60%不是與其他尺寸船閘的差額。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume one cycle exchanges30000m³ and reuses18000m³. Reuse is60% and external supply12000m³;60% is not a comparison with another lock size.

checks.boundary: Constant rate assumption, no field acceptance threshold.
checks.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設持續漏水0.020m³/s維持86400s，日損失Qt=1728m³；僅在漏水率固定時成立，不能由此指定現場允許值。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume constant leakage0.020m³/s for86400s. Daily loss Qt=1728m³; the assumption does not specify an allowable field leakage rate.

checks.boundary: Daily exposed-water loss, not per-lockage loss.
checks.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設總水面12000m²、當日蒸發深0.005m，損失AE=60m³/day；不是每次通航都損失60m³。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume exposed water area12000m² and daily evaporation depth0.005m. Loss AE=60m³/day, not60m³ for every lockage.

checks.boundary: Instantaneous quasi-steady flow, not constant over exchange.
checks.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設等效Cd=0.70、開口4m²、水頭差2m，Q=Cd a√(2gΔh)=17.54m³/s；僅作瞬時準穩態示意。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume effective Cd=0.70,opening4m² and head difference2m. Q=Cd a√(2gΔh)=17.54m³/s is an instantaneous quasi-steady illustration.

checks.boundary: Both finite areas updated; finite residual0.1m and no valve sequence instruction.
checks.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設固定池面積A1=3000、A2=6000m²、a=4m²、Cd=0.7，k=Cd a√(2g)(1/A1+1/A2)；水頭差Δh由6降0.1m，準穩態時間t=2(√6−√0.1)/k=688.0s。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume areas3000,6000m²,opening4m²,Cd=0.7. With k=Cd a√(2g)(1/A1+1/A2), reducing head6to0.1m takes t=2(√6−√0.1)/k=688.0s.

原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設固定水面6000m²、共同水位偏差0.010m，庫容偏差Aδz=60m³；此系統偏差不隨讀值數增加自動消失。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume fixed area6000m² and coherent level bias0.010m. Storage bias Aδz=60m³; additional readings do not automatically eliminate this systematic error.

checks.boundary: Fixed gross demand; reuse change is20percentage points, makeup change50percent.
checks.model: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設每循環30000m³，回用率由0.60降0.40，外部補水由12000升18000m³，增加50%；非只增加20%。~Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume gross exchange30000m³ per cycle. Reuse falls0.60to0.40; makeup rises12000to18000m³, a50% increase rather than20%.

sensitivity.assumptions: Only chamber area rises10%; fixed lift and separately assumed fixed reuse.
